description:
A handsome face and broad shoulders. A man who is prickly to the world but gentle only to her. Yet, he still sees her as just a child. Tonight, Jena is determined to make Woo Tae-kyung fall for her, one way or another. 

"Doing this in front of a man leads to trouble."    

"Even for you, Oppa?"     
Tae-kyung’s expressionless eyes finally curved into a slight smile. The corners of his mouth rose slowly and meaningfully.    

"Yeah, me too." 

*

"I told you I wouldn't be able to handle you."   
  
"I also said I wouldn't be able to stop halfway."    

It was on a completely different level from what she had seen in her dreams. Seeing him pulse and move with such intensity, Jena swallowed hard without realizing it. This... This is... 

"It's... it's even bigger..." 

At that moment, Tae-kyung’s brow furrowed deeply. 

"What?" 

The gentle adult who had been coaxing her was gone. 

"Our little Jena has grown quite bold. Who exactly are you comparing me to right now?"
